properties.evidence: Not the finding itself — a claim this session made ALONGSIDE it, on the same day, and this refutes. Arguing from the approver-loss discovery I concluded that visible-only 'needs none of this machinery' and recommended it as the cheap option. Measured: `settles_intent()` reads only `status == accepted` and never looks at GOVERNED_BY, so a mirrored ACCEPTED decision fails the gate whether it governs anything or not. Visible is only cheap if what arrives is `proposed`, which is a different design from the one I was recommending.
